record.paper: A note on the Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture

dossier_meta.paper: A note on the Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Polynomial bounds for the Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is possible that the Gy\'{a}rf\'{a}s-Sumner conjecture holds with polynomial bounds; that is, 1.1 holds with a bound on the chromatic number that is polynomial in $t$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that polynomial bounds on the $\chi$-bounding function have recently been established for trees not containing $P_5$ as an induced subgraph, and suggest that the full Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture may admit a polynomial $\chi$-bounding function in $t$ for every fixed tree $T$.
